title: Meet the BYD Ti 7: A New Seven-Seat SUV Coming to New Zealand in 2027
excerpt: BYD is expanding its SUV line-up, with the rugged-looking BYD Ti 7 seven-seat plug-in hybrid SUV expected to arrive in New Zealand in 2027. Combining bold, off-road-inspired styling with plug-in hybrid technology and a spacious three-row cabin, the Ti 7 could offer Kiwi families a compelling new option.

title: 15,000 BYDs on New Zealand Roads: A Growing Vote of Confidence
excerpt: Four years after BYD first arrived in New Zealand, more than 15,000 BYD vehicles are now on Kiwi roads. Of those 15,000-plus vehicles, 9,824 are fully electric and 5,248 are plug-in hybrids, meaning thousands of Kiwi drivers have already made the switch away from conventional petrol-powered vehicles.

title: BYD Seal 6 Touring Review: Auto Trader
excerpt: Kiwis love a station wagon. We might buy utes and SUVs by the truckload these days, but there remains a soft spot in the national psyche for a proper low-slung load-lugger. So when BYD landed the Seal 6 Touring here, a plug-in hybrid wagon at $55,990 plus on-road costs, it arrived with a head start.
